modelFields.coverageLabel: Source-linked 120-credit online baseline with five named major electives, retained UNIV 104 and explicit capstone conditions.
rulesNotes: A 120-credit proposed allocation: 30 unique general education + 15 major foundations + 57 major/capstone/elective credits + 18 free-elective credits.
BIOL 102, ENGL 102, MATH 201 and PSYC 101 also meet the specified general-education positions. Their 12 credits are owned and counted once under major foundations.

The baseline retains UNIV 104 at three credits and HSER 497 at three credits. The published UNIV 104 range is 0–3, HSER 499 alternative is 3–6, and free electives range from 3–21. Individual approval of another case requires a new allocation; no waiver is assumed.

The five proposed major electives are PSYC 306, SOWK 432, PSYC 312, PSYC 320 and PSYC 380. Each is upper level, offered online and distinct from every fixed required course and the other selected major electives.
Retain PSYC 430 in the prerequisite sequence: HSER 301/415 require PSYC 430 or SOWK 431, while SOWK 431 itself requires HSER 415 or SOWK 350.
Advanced mental-health practice, therapy or professional counseling may require graduate education and appropriate licensure; the bachelor degree alone does not establish that eligibility.
Do not automatically remove RLGN 104 at 45 transfer credits or THEO 104 at 60 transfer credits. The source permits those waivers, but this ledger retains both courses until individual evaluation.

unresolved.message: Submit official records for Liberty’s individual transfer evaluation, catalog eligibility, major-course residency allocation, state-specific general-education additions and duplicate-learning check.
Before university registration, record accepted prerequisite credit, required placement results and available sections. No assessment result or future section availability is assumed.

Complete zero-credit HSER 465 before HSER 497; satisfy senior standing, Human Services major enrollment and overall GPA of at least 2.0. Apply for and receive departmental approval in the semester preceding HSER 497, and arrange participation in its biweekly synchronous seminars and direct community service.
Additional outside options may improve this route. Proposed university choices do not establish that outside credit is prohibited.

graduationRequirements.detail: Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in the requirements under the catalog major section, including its listed foundations and other named major sections.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 retained at three credits
obligations.notes: This baseline includes the three-credit UNIV 104 case and 18 free-elective credits. An individually approved zero-credit case can release those hours for elective allocation within the source range; no waiver is assumed.

obligations.title: HSER Internship Proposal and Preparation (noncredit prerequisite)
obligations.notes: Complete the online, zero-credit HSER 465 before HSER 497. Its published alternatives are HSER 201/SOWK 101, HSER 270/SOWK 270, and HSER 415/SOWK 350; the baseline uses HSER 201, HSER 270 and HSER 415. This required noncredit step contributes no degree credits.

obligations.title: HSER 497 approval, standing and participation
obligations.notes: Senior standing, enrollment in the Human Services major, overall GPA at least 2.0 and HSER 201/270/301/415/465 must precede HSER 497. Apply for and receive departmental approval in the preceding semester. The capstone includes biweekly synchronous seminars and direct community service.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: 15 major-foundation credits plus 57 major/capstone/elective credits, with the 12-credit general-education overlap counted once.

majorMinInstitutionCredits.calculation: 25% of the retained 72-credit major component is 18 credits at Liberty.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
